summary: Indexed read of a float array with a default sentinel. Loads the array pointer from this+0x8C, forms the index as a2 - 1, and returns the float at that slot when the pointer is non-null and the index satisfies two capacity bounds (this+0x8 and this+0x88). Returns -1.0 (the flt_59E670 sentinel constant) when the pointer is null or the index is out of range. __thiscall double-returning accessor with no side effects.

operations.description: Load the array pointer v2 = this[35] (this+0x8C) and precompute v3 = a2 - 1.
Guard: pass only when v2 (array pointer) is non-null AND v3 >= 0 AND v3 <= this[2] (this+0x8 bound) AND v3 < this[34] (this+0x88 bound); otherwise fall through to the sentinel return.
Compute the element address as v2 + 4 * v3 (scaling the index by float stride 4).
Return the float value stored at the computed element address when the guard passes.
Return -1.0 (the flt_59E670 sentinel flag constant) when the array pointer is null or the index is out of either bound.
Called by sub_4D24D0 (0x004D24D0) and SingleFunctionCallWrapper_ad30 (0x004DAD30) to fetch bounded float-array entries.
